title: trust left open (postgres) — review required
description: trust runs with an open setting: host all all 0.0.0.0/0 trust. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply scram-sha-256 auth and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.

tests.line: # audit: host all all 0.0.0.0/0 trust present
